source.citation: Talker Research for Safeway Moving, March 19-25, 2025, 2,000 U.S. adults (opt-in commercial poll): 39% say they first ask friends for help when moving (https://talkerresearch.com/more-than-a-third-secretly-hate-being-asked-to-help-with-moving/). The base rate is solved so that share of residents' recorded moves draws a favor from at least one person they shared a class or workgroup with.
source.estimatedFrom: A favor at a move comes from how close the pair was at the time: their shared years before the move as hours together, faded since their shared time ended at the half-life for people outside the family; each pair carries its own line, keyed to the pair and the move.
